interpretation: Strict numerical/UI job ran the entire 352-test suite with zero skips in each run. Core-only matrix jobs are separate and may skip unavailable optional dependencies. No original GMS comparison or whole-product completion follows.
retention_note: GitHub artifacts expire; parsed test/solver/example receipts and every artifact member digest are retained here.

jobs.name: Groundwater, transport and UI with pinned real MF6

steps.name: Set the explicit real-engine path before test discovery
Install optional groundwater and UI dependencies
Prepare and verify the exact public MODFLOW 6 binary
Check all tests with actual MF6 and refuse every skip
Export and verify a portable groundwater model
Save, relocate and rerun the spatial project roundtrip example
Retain real-engine evidence even when a check fails

numerical_result.porosity_role: preserved geological metadata; not a flow/storage coefficient in confined GWF
numerical_result.validation_scope: synthetic confined single-phase water; case-specific analytic tests only

solver.json.content_policy: Exact pinned digests; no rolling latest or release-immutability assumption
solver.json.metadata_caveat: Release prose lists MF6 6.6.3; actual verified contained binary identifies 6.7.0.
